baselineMigrationPreservation.comparison: git blob hashes for HEAD prisma/migrations/*/migration.sql versus current database/migrations/*/migration.sql
baselineMigrationPreservation.limitation: Identical historical SQL does not itself prove preservation of existing data during the additional migration.

baselineMigrationUpgrade.scope: isolated baseline database fixture upgraded by real Prisma migrate deploy; checks preserved user, operation setting and membership tables

completeMigrationCheckOnly.database: temporary SQLite with all 53 migration names

pendingMigrationGate.database: temporary SQLite with one migration omitted

applicationWiring.databaseEnvironment: shared root DATABASE_URL normalized against database/schema.prisma

isolatedRestore.migrationSource: tests/helpers/sqlite-fixture.mjs applied all 53 database/migrations to a temporary SQLite file
checks: backup manifest and restored database SHA256 matched
restored uploads/fixture.txt SHA256 and path mapping matched manifest
database upload reference was retained and referenceCount was one
restored SQLite users records matched the fixture
source temporary database SHA256 remained unchanged by restore
repeat restore into the existing target exited one and preserved the restored database SHA256

isolatedInitializeDb.database: new temporary SQLite file under the OS temp directory
isolatedInitializeDb.environment: isolated DATABASE_URL, BACKUPS_DIRECTORY, UPLOADS_DIRECTORY and JWT_SECRET; root .env and user database untouched

formalProductionStartup.environment: isolated 53-migration SQLite, uploads/backups directories, JWT test value, disabled payment/AI and STORY_WORKER_DISABLED=1
formalProductionStartup.processes: root launcher owned live api/admin/web/worker children; exactly one worker_started runner log
formalProductionStartup.tasks: seven sweep tasks registered and no initial task remained RUNNING
formalProductionStartup.cleanup: Windows test recorded the owned process tree and force-cleaned it with taskkill /T /F while the root was alive; ports 3010/3011/3012 verified free afterward

limitations: The formal startup check used only isolated local application processes; it was not a production deployment or online recovery drill.
No production server, database, merchant credential, payment, or refund was contacted.
Temporary SQLite files and temporary upload/backup/restore directories were used only for this local validation.
This is not a production or online recovery drill; no online data, credentials, server, payment, or deployment was accessed.
